comment: Network configuration. Nothing here is hardcoded in gameplay code.
REGION ADDRESSES ARE DELIBERATELY EMPTY. Deploying a server costs money and requires
an account with an infrastructure provider, so no hosted endpoint is shipped and none is
created by the project. Put the address of your own dedicated server into the region you
use, or connect by typing an address in the multiplayer menu, or use LAN discovery.
The first supported region is Europe (eu-central). The client refuses loopback addresses
unless allowLoopbackForDevelopment is set to true - see docs/04_NETWORKING.md.
